h1.en: What Electric 60 vs Electric Low Pressure 60 lists, with Fluid power as the illustration
h1.zh: 电动60和电动低压60混凝土泵有何不同列出的内容，用「流體動力」做插图

directAnswer.en: Electric 60 and Electric Low Pressure 60 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Electric 60 lists 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, a 0.7 m³ hopper and fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power.
directAnswer.zh: 电动60和电动低压60是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动60标出 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、细石 200 m / 600 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power: Hydraulicky lis. Electric 60 and Electric Low Pressure 60 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. Motor power: Electric 60 lists 90 kW. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 75 kW. Fine-stone conveying (H / V): Electric 60 lists 200 m / 600 m. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 150 m / 350 m. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists entries that Electric 60 does not: Model line Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power页上的Hydraulicky lis。电动60和电动低压60是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。理论输送量：电动60标出 40 m³/h；电动低压60标出 35 m³/h。13 mm石子（水平/垂直）：电动60标出 150 m / 450 m；电动低压60标出 100 m / 300 m。看电动60请打开 /zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/，看电动低压60请打开 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Electric 60 lists 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, a 0.7 m³ hopper and fine-stone 200 m / 600 m. Theoretical output: Electric 60 lists 40 m³/h. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 35 m³/h. 13 mm stone (H / V): Electric 60 lists 150 m / 450 m. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 100 m / 300 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 电动60标出 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、细石 200 m / 600 m。最大出口压力：电动60标出 35 MPa；电动低压60标出 30 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: Low Pressure 60 lists the model line Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60, 75 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, a 0.5 m³ hopper and fine-stone 150 m / 350 m. Max. outlet pressure: Electric 60 lists 35 MPa. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 30 MPa. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. The alias Electric 75-60 sits on the low-pressure page beside 75 kW, not on the Electric 60 page. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 低压60的型号行是电动低压60 / 电动75-60，并标出 75 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.5 m³、细石 150 m / 350 m。料斗容积：电动60标出 0.7 m³；电动低压60标出 0.5 m³。电动低压60有、电动60没有的行：型号行 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: The shared word 60 does not merge the rows. Hopper capacity: Electric 60 lists 0.7 m³. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 0.5 m³. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Open /en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric 60 and /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/ for Electric Low Pressure 60.
body.zh: 电机功率：电动60标出 90 kW；电动低压60标出 75 kW。细石输送（水平/垂直）：电动60标出 200 m / 600 m；电动低压60标出 150 m / 350 m。别名电动75-60和 75 kW 写在低压那一页，不在电动60那一页。

question.en: Does Electric 60 list the same motor power as Electric Low Pressure 60?
question.zh: 电动60和电动低压60的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 lists 90 kW. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 75 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60标出 90 kW。电动低压60标出 75 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 60 list the same theoretical output as Electric Low Pressure 60?
question.zh: 电动60和电动低压60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 lists 40 m³/h. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 35 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60标出 40 m³/h。电动低压60标出 35 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 60 list the same max. outlet pressure as Electric Low Pressure 60?
question.zh: 电动60和电动低压60的最大出口压力一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 60 lists 35 MPa. Electric Low Pressure 60 lists 30 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动60标出 35 MPa。电动低压60标出 30 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Where is the model line for Electric Low Pressure 60 shown?
question.zh: 电动低压60的型号行标出在哪里？

answer.en: It is shown on /en/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/ as Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60. It is not shown as that label on the Electric 60 page. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power.
answer.zh: 标出在 /zh/products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump/，数值为 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60。电动60页面没有这个标题。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_power画面里印出的数字。
